stable.notes: Update Server proves any installed provider (Claude, Codex, and Cursor when its agent is present) and commits when at least one real query passes; a vendor session or usage limit is recorded as a skip with its reason instead of rolling the update back. Zero proofs still fails closed. The Morning brief card shows what is behind each source and how the last brief came back. Pairs with server 6.43.3, which returns proof failure codes and accepts Cursor as a proof provider.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
